issues.detail: The skill does not cover all possible error scenarios and edge cases, focusing mainly on migration and basic setup.
The skill contains extensive explanatory text and multiple code examples, which may be considered verbose for a concise skill file.
The installation instructions rely on Ubuntu-specific package names and root privileges, limiting portability to other operating systems.
